profiles.welcome: Learn to code by building your own game!

home.basicsIntro: Learn the building blocks of code with Bit the robot.
home.gamesIntro: Pick a game and build it step by step.

lesson.useArrows: Use the arrow keys on your keyboard!

msg.gameDoneSub: You made a real game with code. Well done!
msg.noStart: Put your blocks inside "when Run is clicked".
msg.noKeys: Add "when key … is pressed" blocks so you can steer.
msg.bump: Ouch! Bit bumped into a wall.
msg.notAtFlag: Not quite! Bit stopped before the flag.
msg.coinsLeft: Almost! {n} coin(s) are still lying there.
msg.scoreWrong: The score is {score}, but it should be {want}.
msg.loop: Your code ran too many times. Is a repeat block too big?
msg.tooManySteps: Bit walked too many steps and got tired.
msg.gameOverNotWall: Game over, but not by the wall. Try steering into the wall!
msg.gameOverNotSelf: Game over, but the snake did not bite itself. Make it long and turn into itself!
msg.scoreGoal: Game over! You got {score}. Try to get {want} points!
msg.snakeLeft: The snake slithered off the screen!
msg.snakeLeftHint: The snake slithered off the screen! Add a rule: if the snake hits the wall, then game over.
msg.noFood: Tip: use "place food" so the snake has something to eat.
msg.noStartCode: Put your code inside function whenRunClicked() { … }
msg.noKeysCode: Write functions like whenKeyUp() { … } so you can steer.
msg.badDirection: "{dir}" is not a direction. Use 'up', 'down', 'left' or 'right'.
msg.badColour: "{colour}" is not a snake colour. Pick one of: {list}.
msg.loopCode: A loop ran far too many times, maybe forever. Check the condition of your loop.

mode.label: How do you want to code?
mode.bothTip: Blocks, with the real code they make next to them

code.commandsTip: Click one to add it to your code.
code.startOverConfirm: Throw away the code you typed in this lesson and start again from your blocks?

help.key: when an arrow key is pressed: whenKeyUp, whenKeyDown, whenKeyLeft, whenKeyRight
help.score: change the score (the number is how much)
help.if: if the question is true, do what is inside { }

err.string: This text has no closing {q}. Text must start and end with {q}.
err.comment: This /* comment */ is never closed with */.
err.extraClose: There is one {ch} too many here.
err.mismatch: Here is a {close}, but the {open} on line {openLine} needs a {want} first.
err.unclosed: This {open} is never closed. Add a {close} where it should end.
err.loopBraces: Put the code for your "{kw}" loop inside { }.
err.eventName: "{name}" should be written {want}. Capital letters matter!
err.syntax: The computer doesn't understand this line. Check for typos. ({detail})
err.notDefined: "{name}" doesn't exist. Check the spelling: capital letters matter!
err.notFunction: There is no command called {name}. Check the spelling, or look in the command list.
err.recursion: A function calls itself again and again, forever.
err.tooMany: You may use {name} only {max} time(s) here, but you used it {used} times. Use a loop!
